quarterly_data.quarter: Cloudflare press release: Cloudflare Announces Public Certificate Authority for the (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cloudflare announced its intent to become a public Certificate Authority supporting both traditional certificates and post-quantum Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs), has applied to the Chrome, Apple, Microsoft and Mozilla root programs, and agreed to acquire publicly trusted Root CA key material from GlobalSign (closing expected in the next two months, subject to customary conditions). Classical certificates will be issued after root program acceptance; production MTC issuance is scheduled to begin in the first quarter of 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: production MTC issuance scheduled from Q1 2027
